description: Fetches mountain range and peak data from Peakbagger.com range pages. Provides detailed range information including peak rankings, elevations, hierarchy, and geographic data. Note: Individual peak and list pages are blocked by Cloudflare, but range pages are fully accessible.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_range: Get detailed information about a mountain range including top peaks, elevations, area, countries, and hierarchy. Requires 'rid' or 'url'.; 参数: rid, url; 必填: url
  - search_ranges: Search for mountain ranges by exploring the range hierarchy. Optional 'start_rid' to begin from a specific range.; 参数: start_rid, max_depth, rid, url; 必填: url
  - get_peak_from_range: Get peak information by finding it within its parent range page. Requires 'rid', optionally 'peak_name' or 'peak_id'.; 参数: rid, peak_id, peak_name, url; 必填: rid, url

rid.description: Range ID number from Peakbagger (e.g., "100" for Brooks Range). Used by get_range, search_ranges, and get_peak_from_range.

url.description: Full Peakbagger URL for a range page (e.g., "https://peakbagger.com/range.aspx?rid=100"). Alternative to rid for get_range.

start_rid.description: Starting range ID for hierarchy exploration. Used by search_ranges. Defaults to "1" (North America).

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for hierarchy traversal. Used by search_ranges. Defaults to 1.

peak_id.description: Peak ID number from Peakbagger. Used by get_peak_from_range for exact match.

peak_name.description: Name of peak to search for (partial match supported). Used by get_peak_from_range.
